CORRECTION 1 (date): on the Q2 call management guided the minority-stake process to the FIRST HALF of 2027, "targeting H1-2027, close as early as possible," with the process taking several months AFTER the Q4 close — not the line's "late-2026/early-2027." BUT the "market cap < the C$25B sports group alone" framing is SoP sleight of hand — C$44B of net debt sits ahead of the common, so the sports mark only reaches holders if telecom EV clears the debt. Both remaining defects are correctly self-disclosed by the line: proceeds are explicitly earmarked to debt paydown (confirmed in Rogers' own language), and the likely structured-equity/preferred-return format would make the C$25B a financing cost rather than common-accretive value. Tradeable, no hidden disqualifier.
verified.analysis: Both legs verify and both are dated and forward: the C$4.35B Kilmer buyout is signed but unclosed (Q4-26, NHL/NBA/MLS approvals outstanding) and the sports/media minority recap at ~C$25B/US$18B is management-committed for late-26/early-27 with no investor signed - so the crystallizing leg is genuinely unfired, and the market has twice sold the news (07-06 announcement closed at a 52w low $31.45; 07-22 earnings/recap disclosure took it from $34.37 to $32.95), leaving ~70% of the derived move unharvested. Net: real event, wrong size - and the dominant swing factor from here is SoCal industrial rent/cap-rate direction, which is a sector-macro bet, not an idiosyncratic one.
